Select criteria at the chosen level. An empty feature list means an unconditional core assessment. Otherwise any true feature selects the criterion; all false means not applicable with reasons; no true and at least one null requires investigation. Higher-level criteria are deferred, which is not an assessment status and never means not applicable. Report serious observed defects at any level, explicitly marking out-of-level observations. 4. For each selected criterion, establish its expected contract, then execute its specific steps with the listed data/environment. Retain the required evidence and record the limits of the sample. Missing requirements, access, tooling, observations or representative users mean unknown rather than pass. 5. Assign status and, for a demonstrated failure, contextual severity. Evaluate modification authority separately using the decision procedure below. Complete the affected-users, benefit verification and scope/cost/risk fields before proposing a change. 6. After an authorized change, execute the criterion's verification steps under the original conditions and check relevant neighboring behavior. Keep before/after evidence; do not mark pass merely because a patch was written. Composite criteria need subcase records within evidence: S05 classifies CSRF, CORS, uploads, public endpoints and abuse independently. O05 distinguishes restore from release rollback. An applicable failed subcase makes the criterion fail; absent subcases need reasons. If no subcase fails but a relevant subcase is untested, the result is unknown. A partly applicable criterion cannot be marked not applicable as a whole. The profile gates planning; it does not replace architecture review or subcase evidence. ## Focused group audits For an agreed group-only audit, use `--group F` (or repeat `--group` for several groups) with `select` and `template`. The report records `criterion_groups`; omitted means all six groups for backwards compatibility. Coverage validation still requires every selected in-scope criterion, including unknowns and exclusions. Other groups have no assessed result. Do not narrow scope after observing a failure merely to make a report pass. Unknown is missing evidence/expectation; it is never counted as pass. Not applicable requires demonstrated feature absence and a written reason. Human/skill review must assess evidence sufficiency, exceptions, feature rationale and the stated cost/risk; schema validation cannot establish those facts. ## Source interpretation WCAG references use the pinned 2.2 Recommendation dated 2024-12-12.
